Pi CNC Studio third-party notices

The Studio source and documentation written for this project use the MIT License,
copyright 2026 Shaun Price. Retain the root LICENSE or Studio-MIT.txt with redistributed copies.
The accompanying fonts, libraries and other upstream materials have separate terms.

opentype.js 2.0.0 — MIT, copyright 2020 Frederik De Bleser.
The upstream minified distribution includes tiny-inflate 1.0.3 by Devon Govett.
This JavaScript decoder is a port of Joergen Ibsen's tinf. Preserve the
opentype, tiny-inflate and tinf license texts in this directory.

Lora, Montserrat and Cormorant Garamond — SIL Open Font License 1.1.
fonts.js embeds the original font files. Keep each family's copyright notice
and OFL file. Lora is a reserved font name under its accompanying notice.

The optional STEP feature uses Open CASCADE Technology, accessed through
CadQuery OCP. Open CASCADE Technology 7.9.3 uses LGPL 2.1 with the Open
CASCADE exception 1.0. OCP wrapper code uses Apache 2.0. Copies of those
texts are included. Shapely's geometry operations use GEOS under LGPL 2.1.
The Studio wheel declares these dependencies separately. Bundling third-party
binaries creates additional distribution obligations described in LICENSING.md.

qrcodegen.js — QR Code generator, Project Nayuki, MIT. See qrcodegen-LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js
